seats.school: Emory College of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Joseph Crespino
records.priorTitle: Senior Associate Dean of Faculty and Divisional Dean of Humanities and Social Sciences, Emory College
records.notes: Named interim dean in January 2026 after Krauthamer stepped down for personal reasons; a national search for a permanent dean was set to begin January 2026 with a goal of appointing someone by fall 2026.

records.name: Barbara Krauthamer
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Humanities and Fine Arts
records.notes: Took office July 1, 2023; first African American dean of Emory College. Stepped down in January 2026 for personal reasons (per Emory Wheel, resignation dated 2026-01-06).

records.name: Michael A. Elliott
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, Emory College of Arts and Sciences (Senior Associate Dean of Faculty, 2009-2014)
records.notes: Served as interim dean starting August 2016 before being appointed dean effective July 1, 2017. Left in 2022 to become president of Amherst College.

records.name: Michael Heithaus
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Served as interim dean from July 2014; formally named dean in 2015 (announcement dated May 7, 2015). Later became Executive Dean of the expanded College of Arts, Sciences & Education and also Vice Provost, Biscayne Bay Campus.

records.name: Kenneth G. Furton
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean / Chemistry Professor
records.notes: Dean of the College of Arts and Sciences 2007-2014; restructured the college into three mission-based interdisciplinary schools. Left to become FIU Provost and EVP (2014-2022).

records.name: Sam Huckaba
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, College of Arts and Sciences (Professor of Mathematics)
records.notes: Served roughly 15 months as interim dean before formal appointment in October 2012. Confirmed still serving as dean via the college's current directory (artsandsciences.fsu.edu/about/people).

seats.school: Fordham College of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Jessica Lang
records.priorTitle: Dean, Weissman School of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Inaugural dean of the newly unified Arts and Sciences structure (combining Fordham College Rose Hill, Fordham College Lincoln Center, and the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences), effective July 1, 2025. Previously led Baruch's Weissman School since 2021.

records.name: Maura Mast
records.priorTitle: Professor of Mathematics
records.notes: Dean of Fordham College at Rose Hill (predecessor structure to the unified Arts & Sciences dean role) starting August 2015 until the 2025 reorganization.

records.name: John P. Harrington
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, Fordham College at Rose Hill
records.notes: Served as interim dean of Fordham College at Rose Hill prior to Maura Mast's 2015 appointment.

seats.school: College of Humanities and Social Sciences

records.name: Ann Ardis
records.priorTitle: Senior Vice Provost for Graduate and Professional Education
records.notes: Began term August 1, 2018; re-appointed to a second five-year term effective 2022/2023 (announcement dated September 20, 2022).

records.name: Robert Matz
records.priorTitle: Faculty member, College of Humanities and Social Sciences
records.notes: Named interim dean effective October 25, 2017 after Deborah Boehm-Davis departed; served until Ann Ardis's arrival in 2018.

records.name: Deborah Boehm-Davis
records.priorTitle: Professor of Psychology
records.notes: Named dean February 2013; departed October 25, 2017 to return to industry (VR/AR/mixed reality research). Succeeded Jack Censer as dean.

records.name: David M. Edelstein
records.priorTitle: Vice Provost for Education
records.notes: Effective July 1, 2025. Faculty member since 2002; previously vice dean for faculty affairs in the College for six years and faculty chair of the School of Foreign Service.

records.name: Andrew Sobanet
records.priorTitle: Professor, Department of French and Francophone Studies
records.notes: Served as interim dean starting July 2024 after Rosario Ceballo's departure, through Edelstein's July 2025 start; launched the Humanities Initiative during his tenure.

records.name: Rosario Ceballo
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Succeeded Christopher Celenza as dean in 2020; left in 2024 to become dean of the University of Michigan's College of Literature, Science, and the Arts.

records.name: Christopher Celenza
records.priorTitle: Professor / Administrator
records.notes: Appointed dean March 2, 2017; assumed office July 1, 2017. Left in 2020 and later returned to Johns Hopkins as Krieger School dean in January 2021.

records.name: Susan Lozier
records.priorTitle: Ronie-Richele Garcia-Johnson Distinguished Professor of Ocean Sciences
records.notes: Named dean April 4, 2019; joined Georgia Tech September 1, 2019. Confirmed as current dean via sciences.gatech.edu leadership page.

records.name: David M. Collard
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Sciences (Professor)
records.notes: Appointed interim dean effective August 1, 2018, following Paul Goldbart's departure to UT Austin.

records.name: Paul Goldbart
records.priorTitle: Professor of Physics
records.notes: Succeeded Paul Houston as dean in 2013; left in June 2018 to become dean at the University of Texas at Austin.

seats.school: Franklin College of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Anna Stenport
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Liberal Arts
records.notes: Became the 17th dean of Franklin College effective June 1, 2023. Previously chaired the School of Modern Languages in Georgia Tech's Ivan Allen College.

records.name: Alan T. Dorsey
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean for Natural Sciences and Mathematics, Professor of Physics
records.notes: Named dean effective July 1, 2012, following a national search after Garnett Stokes's departure and Hugh Ruppersburg's interim term.

records.name: Hugh Ruppersburg
records.priorTitle: Senior Associate Dean, Franklin College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Named interim dean effective August 1, 2011, after Garnett Stokes left to become provost at Florida State University.

records.name: Garnett Stokes
records.priorTitle: Department Head, Psychology
records.notes: Served as Franklin College dean for about seven years (2004-2011) before leaving to become Provost and EVP for Academic Affairs at Florida State University.

seats.school: College of Arts, Languages & Letters (successor to the former College of Arts and Sciences)

records.name: Peter Arnade
records.priorTitle: Professor and Chair, History Department
records.notes: Appointed Dean of the College of Arts & Humanities effective June 28, 2012. That college was merged with the College of Languages, Linguistics & Literature and the School of Pacific and Asian Studies in July 2020 to form the College of Arts, Languages & Letters (CALL), which Arnade continued to lead. Note: UH Manoa's original unified 'College of Arts and Sciences' had already been split into multiple colleges (Arts & Humanities, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences) decades earlier; CALL is the closest present-day successor to the humanities/arts side of that lineage. Confirmed still dean via manoa.hawaii.edu/leadership/deans.

records.name: Rubin Patterson
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Sociology and Criminology
records.notes: Appointed dean January 18, 2019; began role July 2019. Had chaired Sociology and Criminology since 2014. Confirmed as current dean via coas.howard.edu welcome page.

records.name: Edna Greene-Medford
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Served as interim dean through July 1, 2019, when Rubin Patterson took office.

seats.school: College of Liberal Arts and Sciences

records.name: Venetria K. Patton
records.priorTitle: Head, School of Interdisciplinary Studies
records.notes: Holds the title Harry E. Preble Dean of the College of Liberal Arts & Sciences; took office August 2021. Prior deans and exact succession were not confirmable from available sources.

records.name: Caroline Chick Jarrold
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean of Natural and Mathematical Sciences and Research
records.notes: Became interim executive dean effective August 1, 2026, after Rick Van Kooten was removed from the role. A search for a permanent dean was expected to be announced that fall.

records.name: Rick Van Kooten
records.priorTitle: Vice Provost for Research
records.notes: Became executive dean July 1, 2019. Removed from the role effective August 1, 2026 ('not a change I sought'); moved to a special advisor role. Previously chaired the Physics department.

seats.school: College of Liberal Arts and Sciences

records.name: Sara Sanders
records.priorTitle: Dean (unconfirmed prior title)
records.notes: Confirmed as current Dean of CLAS with rank of Professor via the college's official leadership page. Exact appointment year and prior title/institution could not be confirmed from accessible sources; further research recommended.

seats.school: College of Liberal Arts and Sciences

records.name: Benjamin C. Withers
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Liberal Arts
records.notes: Began tenure at Iowa State in April 2024, overseeing 21 academic departments. Predecessor dean/interim details could not be confirmed from accessible sources.

seats.school: Zanvyl Krieger School of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Christopher Celenza
records.priorTitle: Dean, Georgetown College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Holds the title James B. Knapp Dean of the Krieger School of Arts and Sciences; assumed the role January 4, 2021, returning to Johns Hopkins after serving as dean at Georgetown (2017-2020).

records.name: Beverly Wendland
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Biology (Interim Dean from 2014)
records.notes: Selected interim dean May 16, 2014; formally dean from February 12, 2015 to June 30, 2020. Went on to become JHU Provost. (Successor-name detail for the immediate post-Wendland period could not be independently confirmed beyond Celenza's 2021 start; there may have been a brief interim gap in 2020.)
